scenes.vo: How does McDonald's really make money? Not from burgers.
About ninety five percent of its restaurants are run by franchisees, not by McDonald's.
scenes.label: of restaurants are franchised

scenes.vo: That leaves only a sliver of restaurants that McDonald's runs itself.
scenes.title: Who runs the restaurants

scenes.vo: Those franchisees pay McDonald's rent, plus a cut of sales. The rent alone is roughly ten billion dollars a year.
scenes.label: collected in rent each year

scenes.vo: It all started in nineteen sixty one, when the company set up a separate arm to buy and lease land.
scenes.label: the year it became a landlord

scenes.vo: The burger is the reason you show up. The land is the business.
